# Will Godfrey

> Personal website of Will Godfrey: AI strategy and delivery, ex-McKinsey and ex-Appirio, founder of Sightline Geospatial and Miniature Systems, based in Iowa City.

## About

Will Godfrey works on AI strategy and delivery, from the first AI decision to agents running in production. He has built AI systems hands-on since 2021; most recently, he built an agent on Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK for a $6B insurance brokerage that is now in production. Before that he spent nearly nine years at McKinsey & Company on the front-office systems of large enterprises, including as CTO for McKinsey North America's first large-scale digital business building program. He also runs Sightline Geospatial and Miniature Systems from Iowa City.

## Core Information

- **Current work**: Independent consultant, AI strategy and delivery (2025 - Present); Founder, Sightline Geospatial (May 2026 - Present); Founder, Miniature Systems (Mar 2025 - Present)
- **Location**: Iowa City (Remote-first, Atlanta roots)
- **Previous**: McKinsey & Company, Digital Specialist to Expert (Nov 2015 - Jul 2024); Appirio, Consultant to Senior Consultant (Apr 2013 - Oct 2015)
- **Education**: MBA, Management of Technology, Georgia Tech
- **Contact**: Available through the contact button on the website

## Professional Experience

### Independent Consultant, AI Strategy & Delivery (2025 - Present)
AI strategy and hands-on agent building. Most recent work: AI-native delivery models for technology services firms.

### Founder, Sightline Geospatial (May 2026 - Present)
NDAA-compliant aerial inspection, survey and geospatial services for infrastructure, energy, utility, government and engineering clients across Iowa, Illinois, Wisconsin and Minnesota.

### Founder, Miniature Systems (Mar 2025 - Present)
Hardware prototyping studio for engineering-grade additive manufacturing and UAS payload integration, making NDAA-compliant payload accessories for uncrewed aircraft.

### Digital Specialist to Expert, McKinsey & Company (Nov 2015 - Jul 2024)
Advised executive teams and PE investors on go-to-market technology. Joined McKinsey North America's first large-scale digital business building program for two weeks and stayed as its CTO. Helped lead the creation of the practice's tech-enabled sales diagnostic, used at nearly 10 clients, and served as lead faculty for the firm's experienced-hire onboarding.

### Consultant to Senior Consultant, Appirio (Apr 2013 - Oct 2015)
Google Apps and Salesforce delivery. Co-tech lead moving 78,000 Microsoft Exchange users to Google Apps for a top-five U.S. city; rebuilt customer-service processes on Salesforce for a 6,000-person company, with TopCoder crowdsourcing and offshore teams; architect on a medical technology company's Sales Cloud relaunch.
